scope: Preserve CSharp callback input ownership when reusing the same copier for yield and final each.
authority: LlvmEmitter.Statements.cs:739 final RuntimeStreamConsumer has OwnsItem:true; LlvmEmitter.Statements.cs:1900 producer yield invocation has OwnsItem:false; LlvmEmitter.Utilities.cs:158 chooses corresponding cleanup scope.
decision: Pass explicit ownsInputs to the shared copier. Ordinary yield bindings keep readonly flag0; final each owns the produced value using move flag1. No ownership diagnostic weakening.
